title: This Tiny Snake Escapes by Rolling Like a Wheel
description:
Dwarf reedsnakes from Borneo don't just slither away from danger: they roll, reaching up to about 3.7 metres per second, roughly four times their top slithering speed.
A Toho University study in Current Biology filmed 13 snakes and found their bodies strike the ground left, right, left, right, while the head stays steady, facing forward.
